<script lang="ts">
	import { Constants, Utils } from "$lib";
	import API from "$lib/API";
	import { getManga } from "$lib/Context";
	import { onDestroy, onMount } from "svelte";
	const resource = getManga()();
	let timeout = 0, disposed = false;
	const marker = "public-view:manga:" + resource.id;
	onMount(() => {
		if (resource.state !== Constants.State.Published || Utils.isBot()) return;
		try {
			if (sessionStorage.getItem(marker)) return;
			timeout = window.setTimeout(async () => {
				try {
					if (disposed || sessionStorage.getItem(marker)) return;
					const response = await API.Analytics.Manga(resource.id);
					if (!disposed && response?.status === 204) sessionStorage.setItem(marker, "1");
				} catch (cause) { if (!disposed) console.error(cause); }
			}, 1000);
		} catch (cause) { console.error(cause); }
	});
	onDestroy(() => { disposed = true; window.clearTimeout(timeout); });
</script>

<script lang="ts">
	import { Utils } from "$lib";
	import API from "$lib/API";
	import { onDestroy, onMount } from "svelte";
	import { useReader } from "./context.svelte";
	const { chapter: resource } = useReader();
	let timeout = 0, disposed = false;
	const marker = "public-view:chapter:" + resource.id;
	onMount(() => {
		if (!resource.published_at || resource.deleted_at || resource.is_unavailable || !resource.data?.length || Utils.isBot()) return;
		try {
			if (sessionStorage.getItem(marker)) return;
			timeout = window.setTimeout(async () => {
				try {
					if (disposed || sessionStorage.getItem(marker)) return;
					const response = await API.Analytics.Chapter(resource.id);
					if (!disposed && response?.status === 204) sessionStorage.setItem(marker, "1");
				} catch (cause) { if (!disposed) console.error(cause); }
			}, 1000);
		} catch (cause) { console.error(cause); }
	});
	onDestroy(() => { disposed = true; window.clearTimeout(timeout); });
</script>
